launches.body:
**Parrot is an end-to-end operating system for auto repair shops.** 🦜

<https://youtu.be/ruo4PUCUHL4>

#### 📈 The pattern

Across industries, the winners all did the same thing: replace the tool an industry uses to record work with software that runs it.

* **Home services:** QuickBooks → ServiceTitan (\~$7B)
* **Construction:** Excel → Procore (\~$7B)
* **Restaurants:** Micros → Toast (\~$15B)

#### 🔧 Why auto repair got skipped

But the $200B auto repair industry is still stuck on manual phone calls, messages, and emails, because the real work is all human conversation: calling warehouses, chasing adjusters, updating customers. That couldn't have been automated until now.

#### 🤖 What Parrot does

Parrot's OS understands the full context of the shop (estimates, parts, customers, insurers, suppliers, and payments), so our agents can physically call and coordinate with real people to run the shop on autopilot.

#### 👥 Who we are

Phillip got his start in biomedical research at Stanford in high school, writing software to automate tedious lab tasks. He later worked on workflow automation for legacy businesses during an internship at Amazon. Liam dropped out of his Master's in Computer Engineering at the University of Illinois Urbana-Champaign (UIUC), where he specialized in applied machine learning and systems automation.

Together on their last startup, Phillip and Liam automated multimodal workflows for biomedical researchers, and now they're bringing that same workflow experience to the shop floor.

#### 🚗 Where we are now

Since pivoting three weeks ago, Phillip and Liam have been working in collision shops every day alongside owners and operators, learning how the work actually gets done, and have secured two independent auto shops signed at $30K annually.

**Schedule a demo at [useparrot.com](http://useparrot.com)**
